raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The v2 card collector, rolling out since 2026-01-16, emits txn_ts in UTC, while legacy emits America/Chicago local time. The pipeline treats every txn_ts as local time, so v2 rows are shifted +6h (CST in January). That pushes evening transactions into 00:00-06:00 and spills them into a spurious 2026-01-19 date; samples confirm this, with v2 rows at 12:0x matching legacy rows at 06:0x.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.86, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
